userManual.introduction: To protect personnel and equipment, operators must read, understand and comply with the following requirements before starting or using the RBTS1 Rebar Tying Robot:
userManual.training: Only personnel who have completed training provided or approved by our company and obtained a valid certificate of competency may operate this machine. The operator and their employer accept responsibility for the risks and consequences of unauthorised operation without such certification.
userManual.preOperationInspection: Before each operation, inspect the machine structure, tying gun, wire reel, battery, sensors, E-stop and protective devices. Do not start the machine if any component is loose, damaged or jammed, or if a fault or abnormal alarm is present.
userManual.personalProtection: Follow all site safety requirements and wear the required personal protective equipment, including a safety helmet, protective gloves, safety footwear and suitable fall-protection equipment.
userManual.exclusionZone: Establish a controlled work area while the machine is operating and keep unauthorised personnel away. Never place hands, feet or any other body part near the tying gun, moving mechanisms or beneath the machine.
userManual.startupProcedure: After power-up and motor self-test, confirm that no fault alarms are active. Then select “Lower to Operating Position” and verify that the machine is stable before starting work.
userManual.authorisedSettings: Set operating parameters only within the specified limits. Do not modify the machine, remove guards, disable sensors or bypass safety controls without prior written approval from our company.
userManual.faultResponse: If abnormal noise or movement, loss of communication, a wire jam or a fault alarm occurs, stop work immediately and activate the E-stop. Do not restart until the hazard has been removed and a competent person has confirmed that operation is safe.
userManual.maintenance: Before cleaning, replacing tie wire, clearing a jam, inspecting or servicing the machine, shut it down, disconnect the power supply and confirm that all moving parts have stopped. Maintenance may be performed only by authorised, competent personnel.
userManual.disclaimer: These safety instructions do not replace the complete equipment manual, a site-specific risk assessment or applicable local safety regulations.
